nvme.name: 1x Kingston KC3000 1 TB behind the X570 chipset, link PCIe 4.0 x2 (LUKS + btrfs; store dir NOCOW)
nvme.note: measured 2026-10-08 while the GLM-5.3-Flash NVMe tier was saturated (9,474,048 B O_DIRECT records): nvme1n1 read rate over 0.1 s windows p50 3.20-3.34, p95 3.35-3.45, p99 3.38-3.54 GB/s (/proc/diskstats via moetier probe record). glm53 verify-store: 117.33 GB O_DIRECT re-read + sha256 at 2.48 GB/s (hash-bound, lower bound). bw_qd1_gbps and latency_ms not measured, so they are omitted and spec.resolve falls back to bw_gbps and 0.1 ms. The chipset uplink (PCIe 4.0 x4) is shared with another GPU, the NIC and SATA.

ceilings.pcie_note: pcie_h2d_gbps = measured host->device copy; D2H not measured. pcie_raw_gbps = Gen4 x8 line rate.
ceilings.pcie_nvml_note: NVML rx during staged prefill (TTFT step, 8k and 32k prompts) on both RAM caps: p95 14.65-14.75, p99 14.76-14.90 GB/s = link saturation in NVML units (KB/s x 1024)
ceilings.ddr_note: 2ch DDR4-3200 = 51.2 GB/s theoretical. Not measured with an AVX2 read sum; the only host measurement is a 16.6 GB/s single-stream host memcpy, which is not a bandwidth ceiling, so ddr_practical_gbps is left null.
ceilings.gpu_power_note: board power limit reported by nvidia-smi
